factor_name: Volatility-Scaled Short-Term Reversal with Medium-Trend Confirmation

calculation.description: Ranks assets favoring five-day losers after volatility normalization; the signal is damped when the five-day move agrees with the sixty-day trend, reducing continuation exposure. All inputs are lagged to the completed observation date.

validation.regime_notes: Positive 10-day IC and ICIR across the full 15-asset cross-asset universe; uncertainty is interpreted conservatively because the average daily cross-section is about 11.3 instruments. Coverage is reduced by the 20-day volatility warm-up and source-data gaps.
